thread:
noah (design): quick UX pass on the autoscale control row. two small goals: make burst copy less scary and ensure guardrail isn't color-only.
riley (product): yes please. product ask: users shouldn't be surprised by billing language but need to be warned.
chandler (eng): FYI the control sits in a virtual list; keep DOM changes minimal.
noah (design): proposed burst copy: "Burst: temporary capacity 014 additional charges possible". CTA: "How burst affects billing" -> docs.
mira (a11y): prefer "additional charges possible" over "costs may increase". a11y: info icon needs 44px hit area and an sr-only label. tooltips dismissible with Esc and have aria-describedby.
riley (product): agree on copy. also flag: on very small screens the tooltip width should cap at 300px.
chandler (eng): will cap to 300px and make it scrollable if it overflows. show on tap/focus only; no hover on touch.
noah (design): guardrail visual proposal: small chip labeled "Guardrail" plus diagonal hatch pattern when active. tooltip: "Guardrail active 014 autoscaler prioritizes latency SLO; short-term extra capacity may be used."
mira (a11y): good. use aria-live="polite" for state changes and debounce 1s to avoid screen reader spam. do not rely on color alone.
chandler (eng): implementation note: we'll debounce and emit a single polite update. also sync slider aria attributes (aria-valuemin/max/now) and add aria-describedby to link helper text.
riley (product): product request: add a tiny line under SLO label: "May affect cost" (non-numeric) so users know there's tradeoff without scary numbers.
noah (design): updated helper: "Latency target (ms) 014 soft goal. May affect cost if autoscaler adds capacity."
qa-bot: preflight: staging/ui-autoscale-copy-v1 queued -> deploy in ~7m. run keyboard + screen reader smoke tests after deploy.
noah (design): thanks all 014 I'll update figma and paste final copy/aria notes here after deploy. :thumbsup:
